title: Global injectivity and real Jacobian conjecture in $\mathbb{R}^n$
summary: In this paper, we study the global injectivity of local diffeomorphisms in $\mathbb{R}^n$, extending the criterions of Braun and Llibre in [{\it Pacific J. Math.} {\bf 333} (2024) 1--15] from the planar radial case to arbitrary dimension. Then we extend the results of Llibre and Mello in [{\it Bull. Sci. Math.} {\bf 213} (2026) 103889] to arbitrary dimension, obtaining two necessary and sufficient conditions for the real Jacobian conjecture in $\mathbb{R}^n$ by qualitative theory of differential equations.
